title: No More Junk
notes: Useless drops (worse than your gear even at +15) are salvaged automatically right after the fight. The victory screen shows what you got for them.
Salvage useless now really removes every item marked ✖, set pieces included (Equip best already picks sets when they help).
The salvage button is big and shows the Mana Stones and Gold you get at a glance.
Commons get rarer in higher gates: in D-Rank most Commons become Rares, in C-Rank almost all do.
Setting in the menu: Auto-salvage useless drops (on by default).
